candidate_facts.text: The U.S. defense strategy in January 1950 did not include Korea as part of its defensive perimeter.
The exclusion of Korea from the U.S. defensive perimeter left it vulnerable to attack.
General MacArthur believed China would not enter the war.
General MacArthur pushed U.N. forces beyond the 38th parallel.
Pushing U.N. forces beyond the 38th parallel provoked a Chinese intervention.

sub_narrative: "What major strategic or political mistakes were made during the war?"
